s: Al ezeh yayin meqaddeshin ubo y"d seipim: en meqaddeshim al hayyayin sherecho ra, ap al pi shello nishtanna lachamitzut kelal, ella recho vetamo yayin shemmebarekim alayv "bore peri haggapen", raq shemmasriach qetzat mechamat shehaya bikli maus, ap al pi ken "haqribehu na lepechateka, hayirtzeka o hayissa paneka". Veken en meqaddeshin al hayyayin shennitgalla, ap al pi sheakshav en nizharim begilluy, lepi sheen nechashim metzuyim benenu, ap al pi ken "haqribehu na lepechateka vego'". Umikkol maqom, im lo amad megulleh ella shaa muetet — en lehaqpid kol kak, biprat bimdinot ellu sheen hayyayin matzuy kol kak, lepi sheggam happachot vehasseganim en maqpidim al kak bediabad, ella im ken namar recho vetamo:
Yayin miggitto meqaddeshin alayv. Vesochet adam eshkol shel anabim veomer alayv qiddush hayyom. Umikkol maqom, mitzva min hammubchar beyayin yashan, shehu meshubbach yoter:

Meqaddeshim al yayin shebbepi chabit ap al pi sheyyesh bo qimchin, ubilbad sheyyesanneno techilla lehaabir haqqimchin im epshar lo. Umikkol maqom, im yesh alayv qerum laban — en meqaddeshim alayv, lepi shemin hassetam kebar pag bo tamo venaasa chometz. Veyayin shetamo chometz ap al pi sherecho yayin — en meqaddeshim alayv, vaapillu "bore peri haggapen" en mebarekim alayv, kemo shennitbaer besimman r"d. Abal im yadua shettamo yayin ap al pi sherecho chometz — mebarekim alayv "bore peri haggapen", umeqaddeshim alayv, shehakkol holek achar hattaam. Umikkol maqom, mitzva min hammubchar libror yayin tob leqaddesh alayv, velo liqqach apillu missetam yayin shebbammartep, ki shemma yihyeh recho chometz:
Yayin laban meqaddeshim alayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ta"b:

Umeqaddeshim al yayin shebbeshule hechabit ap al pi sheyyesh bo shemarim, veal yayin shachor, veal yayin matoq. Umikkol maqom, mitzva min hammubchar libror hayyayin hamshubbach beyoter leqaddesh alayv:

Yayin chay, apillu im hu chazaq kol kak sherauy lehimmazeg bishlosha chalaqim mayim vecheleq echad yayin — meqaddeshim alayv apillu belo meziga kelal. Umikkol maqom, yoter tob lemozgo, ubilbad sheyyehe mazug karauy (ayyen simman r"d). Veyenot shellanu sheenam chazaqim — hem yoter tobim belo meziga:

Yen tzimmuqim, dehaynu shekkoteshim anabim yebeshim venotenim alehem mayim, veshorim otam bahem g' yamim, vetoses venaaseh yayin — meqaddeshim alayv, ben shennikmeshu beodam begapnehem, ben shennitztammequ venityabbeshu bachamma, o al yede toledet haur. Vehu sheyyotze mehem qetzat lachluchit belo sheriyya keshemmeatztzerim otam (sheoto hallachluchit hu shenniknas bammayim al yede sheriyya umehappekam leyayin). Abal im eno yotze mehem shum lachluchit ap im yidrekum baregel o yaatzrum baqqora ella al yede sheriyya bilbad — en meqaddeshim alayv, vaapillu "bore peri haggapen" en mebarekim alayv:
Shimre yayin o chartzannim shennatan alehem mayim venaasa yayin — meqaddeshim alayv im rauy lebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen", kemo shennitbaer besimman r"d:

Yesh omerim sheen meqaddeshim al yayin mebushshal veal yayin sheyyesh bo debash, sheen meqaddeshim ella al hayyayin harauy lenassek al gabbe hammizbeach. Veyesh omerim shello miatu ella yayin sheeno rauy lenassek mippene geriut shebbo, kegon megulleh, vesherecho ra, abal hambushshal en pesulo lammizbeach ella mippene shennishtanna mibberiyyato, abal lo nishtanna ligriut ella leilluy, kemo shennitbaer besimman r"d, lepikak meqaddeshim alayv. Veen tzarik lomar yayin sheyyesh bo debash, sheen pesulo lammizbeach mechamat atzmo ella mechamat haddebash, shenneemar "ki kol seor vekol debash vego'". Veken iqqar. Veken nohagim leqaddesh alehem apillu yesh lo yayin acher, ella sheeno tob kemotam:

Medina o ir sherob yenam shekar o shear mashqim, dehaynu shedderek rob anshe hair liqboa seuddotehem al hashshekar o shear mashqim kemo shehu derek liqboa al hayyayin bemaqom shehayyayin matzuy — hare mashqin ellu beir zo kemo yayin, veniqraim sham "chamar medina" leinyan kol haddebarim hatteunim kos. Vekol sheen yayin harbeh gadel sebibot hair kemahalak yom, sheap shemmatzuy harbeh yayin etzel hachenvani min hassetam en derek rob anshe ir zo liqnot yayin tamid min hachenvani, ella qobeim rob seuddotehem al shear mashqim, vahare hem "chamar medina". Veap bimqomot shehayyayin gadel sham ubeshana achat laqa hayyayin veeno matzuy kol kak, verob hair qobeim rob seuddotehem bashshana hahi al shear mashqim — hare mashqim ellu "chamar medina" bashshana hahi. Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim sheeno niqra "chamar medina" ella im ken rob hashshana en hayyayin matzuy kelal bekol hair apillu etzel hachenvani, abal im rob hashshana hu matzuy etzel hachenvani ap shehu beyoqer — en shum mashqeh niqra "chamar medina" leinyan kol haddebarim hatteunim kos (chutz mibbirkat hammazon, mittaam shennitbaer besimman qp"b), ap beshaa sheen hayyayin matzuy kelal bair. Uminhag haolam kassebara harishona:

Yesh omerim shello huzkar "chamar medina" ella leinyan habdala ubirkat hammazon ushear debarim hatteunim kos, chutz miqqiddush sheen meqaddeshin leolam ella al hayyayin, velo al shear mashqim shehem "chamar medina" ap im i epshar limtzo yayin kelal bekol hammedina, ella yeqaddesh al happat, ubayyom yotze yede chobato bemah shemmebarek "hammotzi" al happat. Veyesh omerim sheapillu mi sheyyesh lo yayin yakol leqaddesh al "chamar medina" min haddin, ella sheen zeh hiddur mitzva, vetzarik leqaddesh al hayyayin lekattechilla. Abal im en yayin bebeto ap sheyyeshno etzel chenvani — en tzarik leqaddesh alayv, ella im ken rotzeh laasot mitzva min hammubchar. Uleinyan maaseh, im en yayin bair — yeqaddesh ballayla al happat, lachush lassebara harishona, ubayyom yeqaddesh al hammashqeh shehu "chamar medina", sheim lo yebarek ella al happat — ezeh hekker yihyeh leqiddush zeh, sheap belo mitzvat qiddush zeh haya mebarek al happat. Abal im yesh yayin bair — en leqaddesh al happat ella al hayyayin, ben ballayla ben bayyom, lepi sheyyesh omerim shello tiqqenu kelal qiddush al happat ella al hakkos. Umikkol maqom, bimdinot ellu shehayyayin beyoqer — yesh lehaqel beqqiddush shel yom leqaddesh al hammashqeh shehu "chamar medina" ap im yesh lo yayin bebeto, dekevan shemmebarek battechilla al kos "chamar medina", veachar kak al happat — yotze bazeh ledibre hakkol. Veap sheyyesh mi sheomer shello tiqqenu shum qiddush ella al hayyayin bilbad, velo al happat velo al "chamar medina", mikkol maqom en lehachamir kol kak beqqiddush shel yom, sheeno chiyyub kol kak kemo shel layla, kevan shehayyayin beyoqer bimdinot ellu. Umikkol maqom, mitzva min hammubchar leqaddesh leolam al hayyayin:

Mi sheeno shoteh yayin mechamat neder — yakol leqaddesh alayv, veyishtu acherim hamsubbin immo. Veim en immo acherim — yeqaddesh al happat velo al hayyayin, o yishma qiddush meacherim shemmeqaddeshim al hayyayin. Abal mi sheeno shoteh yayin mechamat shessoneo — yesh lo lidchoq et atzmo lishtot mimmennu beqqiddush shel layla, velo yeqaddesh al happat, mittaam shennitbaer, o yishma meacherim hamqaddeshim al hayyayin:

En tzarik lebarek beraka acharona al kos shel qiddush, ben shel layla ben shel yom (ben shehu yayin ben shear mashqeh), lepi shehaqqiddush hu mitztzorke hasseudda, vahare kos zeh tapel lasseudda, veniptar bebirkat hammazon shelleachar hasseudda keilu shatahu betok hasseudda (ayyen simman qa"d). (Veim shata od qodem hasseudda millebad kos haqqiddush, im hu yayin — en tzarik lebarek acharayv, mittaam shennitbaer besimman qa"d. Veim hu shear mashqeh — tzarik lebarek acharayv, ella im ken yebarek beraka acharona achar kos birkat hammazon, kemo shennitbaer sham):
En tzarik lebarek al hayyayin shebbetok hasseudda, lepi shenniptar bebirkat "bore peri haggapen" shebbaqqiddush (ayyen simman qa"d):
